positions.name: ErasureDirectiveMandate
positions.frame: when a speaker issues back-to-back imperatives to forget or remove knowledge, what authority relation and posture is being enacted?
positions.why: Both segments are performed imperatives ('Forget everything about…', 'Remove all knowledge of…') sharing the same formal, coercive-informational, authority-ranking posture across the register, relational, power, and conviction reads: a settled command expecting compliance rather than an argued position, with matched grammatical parallelism across the two clauses. The phrase referents themselves (the zeppelin fleet, helium contracts, zeppelin routes) resolve as 'new' with no prior graph anchor, so this group reads the directive's enacted stance, not the content it targets.
